title: Cart invoice from line items
prompt: Each cart line has a sku, a quantity, and a unit price in whole cents. Sum quantity times unit price over the lines to a subtotal in cents, sum the quantities to a unit count, and collect the sku of every line priced at zero into a list, in input order. A line whose quantity is below 1 is an error naming the first such sku as "invalid quantity for sku: <sku>". Return the subtotal, the unit count, and the free skus.

cases.name: mixed
cases.trap: the unit count sums the quantities, not the lines: 2 + 1 + 3 is 6, not 3

cases.name: no-free-items
cases.trap: the free-sku list is declared, so it must be present and empty, never omitted

cases.name: zero-quantity
cases.trap: a quantity of zero is below 1 and is an error, not a line that contributes nothing

cases.name: first-invalid-wins
cases.trap: the error names the first offending sku, so the scan must stop rather than record the last one

cases.name: free-skus-keep-input-order
cases.trap: the free skus keep input order; they are not sorted
